 Somasekhar Sundaresan, Jj.

According to the petitioners, this is a case where land of the petitioners, which was purchased by the petitioners under a registered sale deed dated 20 January, 2006 and consequently mutated under entry no. 6048, has been utilized for the purposes of a village road without acquisition.

The claim of the petitioners is accordingly for a lawful process to be followed and for the compensation to be paid to the petitioners under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparent in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
